summary: An on/off switch for a setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label beside the switch and its accessible name. Required: an external label cannot name a control inside the component (SB-0009).

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when other visible text on the row names the setting.

description.note: Help text under the label, read as the switch's accessible description.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and blocks form submission (customError, SB-0009).

size.note: Track 32x20 (default) or 24x16 (sm). The label and description keep their size; only the track and thumb change.

name.note: Form field name. Without it the switch submits nothing.

value.note: Submitted under name while the switch is on; nothing is submitted while it is off (SB-0101).

checked.note: Whether the switch is on. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset (SB-0101).

required.note: Must be on for the form to submit (valueMissing while off). Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Cannot be focused or toggled; dimmed; not submitted. A disabled fieldset ancestor has the same effect without changing this attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: the switch in the first column; label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Positions the track and thumb over the native input; same height as the label's first line.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: The native checkbox with the switch role; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.notes: Pill-shaped track; off fill input, on fill primary. Decorative (the input carries the semantics).

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round thumb; at the inline start when off, at the inline end when on. Its position, not only the color, shows the state.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native label for the input, in the same root; clicking it toggles the switch.

anatomy.name: required-indicator
anatomy.notes: Asterisk, aria-hidden; required is conveyed natively.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; its text appears while the field is invalid.

input.note: Each user toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the component boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed, once per user toggle. Re-dispatched from the host because the native change is not composed. Not fired when checked is set by code or by form reset.

hover.trigger: pointer over an enabled switch or its label

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track, offset from it so it reads against both the off and on fills.

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb moves to the inline end.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after the user toggled it off, left it, or a submit was attempted
invalid.note: Track outlined in destructive, and the error text shows; color is never the only cue.

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native label for the input in the same root.

formAssociation.note: Form-associated custom element (FormAssociated + NativeControl). Submits value under name only while on; form reset restores the checked attribute (the default); form state restore sets checked; a disabled attribute or disabled fieldset ancestor makes it non-focusable and unsubmitted; required mirrors the inner input's valueMissing; error sets customError; a label for the host toggles it.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20 (sm 24x16); the label beside it is part of the clickable row, so the target spans the switch, the gap and the label. The 12px gap keeps the switch clear of other targets (WCAG 2.5.8).
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input: 3px solid ring in switch.focus-ring.color, offset by switch.focus-ring.offset from the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: moves focus to and from the switch (skipped while disabled)
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission, SB-0009); it does not toggle (SB-0101)

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; its checked state is exposed as aria-checked true/false natively
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
track and thumb are decorative (aria-hidden); the label text does not change with the state
announcements: on/off is announced by the switch role on toggle
error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A single setting that is either on or off, such as enabling notifications
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting, not the state

useCases.when: The setting needs its consequence explained
A dense list of settings, a toolbar or a table row
A standalone setting or a settings form
The form must not submit until the setting is on
useCases.use: required with a label stating what turning it on means; prefer a checkbox for agreements
error with a message saying why and what to do

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a choice that only takes effect after a separate confirm, or for agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as a setting that is on or off now; a recorded choice or an agreement reads as a checkbox

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing one of several options with several switches
antiPatterns.why: Switches are independent; nothing tells the person only one can be on

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state ("On" / "Off") or names the state instead of the setting
antiPatterns.why: The role already announces on/off; a changing label makes the name unstable and the meaning ambiguous
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label naming the setting, such as "Email notifications"

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch with a partial or mixed state
antiPatterns.why: A switch has only on and off; it has no mixed value

antiPatterns.pattern: A toolbar button that turns formatting on and off
antiPatterns.why: That is a pressed button, not a form setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Label and Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside

drift.contract: 3px solid ring color, offset from the track
20px default track (size.switch.height) with a 2px inset around a 16px thumb
drift.realization: shadcn uses a 1.15rem track with a 1px transparent border; rounded to the size scale

drift.contract: thumb background when off, primary-foreground when on, in every mode
drift.realization: shadcn switches the off thumb to foreground in dark mode; one rule per state keeps the contrast pairs declarable

drift.contract: built in, with an aria-hidden required asterisk
drift.realization: not part of the shadcn Switch
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted from the visual reference, the WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern and the form-associated-controls rule?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern (role switch, Space toggles), the visual reference's two sizes default and sm, label row beside the switch like Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Native checkbox with role=switch, or a button with role=switch and aria-checked?
openQuestions.answer: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch> (SB-0007 native first, SB-0101): native validity for required, native label activation, Space handling and checked semantics. A button would need all of those re-implemented.

openQuestions.question: What does an off switch submit?
openQuestions.answer: Nothing. value (default "on") is submitted only while on (SB-0101). An "off value" prop was rejected: no native control has one and servers already treat a missing field as off.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG: optional) or submit the form?
openQuestions.recommendation: Enter submits the form; only Space toggles.
openQuestions.answer: Enter submits (implicit submission, SB-0009), consistent with Checkbox and the native checkbox; Space toggles. The APG lists Enter as optional (SB-0101).

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No. The checked attribute is the default that form reset restores (like native defaultChecked), the same as Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and where does it sit?
openQuestions.recommendation: Required; after the switch on the same row, with hide-label for rows named by other text.
openQuestions.answer: Required, after the switch at the inline end, description and error under the label (the Checkbox layout). A label-before-switch placement prop was left out until a use case asks for it.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.recommendation: default and sm, the visual reference's two sizes.
openQuestions.answer: default (32x20 track, 16px thumb) and sm (24x16 track, 12px thumb), from the existing size.switch tokens. Registered names already map default->medium and sm->small (spec/api.json aliases).

openQuestions.question: Manual screen-reader pass (VoiceOver, NVDA) of the on/off announcement and the error live region.
openQuestions.recommendation: Run during the a11y audit before beta.
